trials.summary: Trial 01 (sigma_ref 23.97, lr_mu 8.60, lr_gamma 0.960, gamma_anneal 0.384): objective 0.1907 +/- 0.0310; mu recovers at a clean ~50% of truth on all 8 experiments, gamma only at high transmission
trials.key_insight: The real-data attractor floor (~half of mu_true) is uniform across all 8 experiments and dominates the objective, while gamma is recovered well only at high transmission.

trials.summary: Trial 02 (sigma_ref 6.84, lr_mu 25.36, lr_gamma 0.439, gamma_anneal 0.196): objective 0.2075 +/- 0.0377, slightly worse than trial_01; mu gap -45..-69%, gamma good only at high transmission
trials.key_insight: The ~half-truth mu attractor is robust to a more aggressive lr_mu / low sigma_ref config (the mu gap even widens at high transmission); gamma low-transmission collapse is the other persistent loss contributor.

trials.summary: Trial 03 (sigma_ref 16.64, lr_mu 25.03, lr_gamma 0.389, gamma_anneal 0.064): objective 0.2472 +/- 0.0509, worst so far; mu attractor near half-truth, gamma collapses to ~-82% at Trans05
trials.key_insight: Near-zero gamma anneal (0.064) coincides with a hard low-transmission gamma collapse (~15-20% of truth on both powers), the largest single loss contributor so far.
